en:
...That's true. You never back down
from a challenge, do you, Kaito?
Right!?

No way a man who's gonna explore the 
universe should freak out about this!
Especially to you.
...To me?

I can't show weakness in front 
of my sidekick.

Just forget about whatever 
it was you heard before.

I was unsure for a sec, but now I'm 
overflowing with motivation!

<CLT=cltMIND>He sounds like he's
hiding something...
<CLT=cltMIND>I think this conversation went well.

I don't know about that, Kaito...
It's okay to be afraid sometimes...

It's not like me to make 
others worry...

I-I'm not trying to "worry"
about you or anything...
It's fine...

What have I done?
I'm so embarrassed.

I've failed my sidekick... Sorry, but 
can you leave me alone for a bit?
<CLT=cltMIND>Damn, this is awkward...

You never show me your
weakness, Kaito.

Yeah! No way I'd do that. It's as 
absurd as saying you're an alien.
It's not *that* absurd...
No, to me it's a really big deal.

But I can't really shake this 
mood just yet...

Sorry, but could you leave 
me alone for now?

<CLT=cltMIND>It seems like that didn't
go well...

I'm your sidekick...
but I'm also your friend, Kaito.

Maybe you don't show weakness to your
sidekick. But you can to your friend.

If you don't want to open up
to your sidekick...

maybe you'll open up to your
best friend. How about it, Kaito?
Shuichi...

Thanks.
I'm alright now.
What? Are you sure?

Now that I know you think of me 
like that... All my doubts are gone!

Alright! Let's escape this screwed 
up academy together!

<CLT=cltMIND>Good, it seems like
we both had a lot of fun.
